newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil extends gains at close on export data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil extends gains at close on export data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES -Supportive export data for January helped to push prices higher at the close. Trading was volatile with a lot of spread trades and speculative buying seen, pushing April fut to high of 1,300 rgt. Next resistance level is 1,310.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Market also firmed in line with futures. But trading is expected to range bound next week becasue of both Chinese Lunar New Year and Moslem Eid-al-Fitri festivals.
Caleb Brett put Malaysia's January bulk palm oil exports at 616,372 tonnes against its estimate of 702,082 for December,
Traders has earlier estimated to be around 580,000 tonnes.
Trading was fairly volatile in the afternoon with a lot of buying appearing after third month April futures was traded at its resistance of 1,300 ringgit level.
"The contract (April futures) was holding relatively firm at 1,300 but there were intermittent profit-taking and selling were seen at this level," another trader said.
At the close, April futures contract was 11 ringgit higher at 1,296 ringgit ($521.32) a tonne.

Traders expect the contract to trade in a tight range next week due to the approaching Chinese New Year and Moslem Eid-al-Fitri holidays. The market is closed from February 6 until 11 for both the festivals.
"There was still a lot of switching activity mainly from March/April and March/May," the trader added.
Physicals Feb (south) crude palm oil was offered 1,350 ringgit against 1,345 after trading at 1,340 to 1,345.
Feb (central) was offered at 1,350 and bids at 1,340 with early trades at 1,340 and Feb (north) at 1,340 against 1,335.
Mar (south) saw offers at 1,340 with bids at 1,335, Mar (central) at 1,340 against 1,327.50.
Among refined products, Feb RBD palm oil was offered at $567.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Mar at $562.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $550. Mar was traded at $560.
Feb RBD palm olein saw offers at $597.50, Mar at $592.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $582.50. Feb was traded at $593, Mar at $590.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $580.
Feb/Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $460 and Feb/Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $305. -- Tan Lee Lee - (603-230-7510) ($1 =2.4860 ringgit)
